notes: The composed gate reads the caption's prose for one purpose: a clause stating a number must name the fact that number was declared against. Without it a caption could declare all three sector clearances correctly and write each one against the wrong sector, which satisfied every other check and was false in every clause. Attribution is still taken from the declaration, so the reading can only refuse and never admit, and Chapter 3 paragraph 740's objection to inferred attribution is not engaged.

RG_SUBJECT_MISMATCH is revived to carry it. The code was retired with the templated contract on 21 August 2026, where it meant a clause whose subject was not the fact the clause was chosen for. That is the same failure, read off a sentence the model composed rather than one the runtime wrote, so the enumeration is unchanged and only the description of that member is corrected. Six of the seven retired codes remain unreachable.

A caption states a measurement as the deterministic renderer displays it, character for character. The comparison had been made on the parsed value with both sides rounded, which accepted 1.7449 metres against a measured 1.74 and accepted both 2 metres and two metres against a measurement displayed as 2.00 metres. One sensor reading now reaches the user in one form whichever path the release took.

The identifier exclusion that lets a model copy visual:1 into the prose tested the single character before a digit. Clearance:9.99 metres therefore passed the undeclared-number check untouched and an invented distance reached the display. The identifier shapes are enumerated and masked instead.

An accepted caption records the facts it declared as its scene binding. It had inherited the binding of the deterministic sentence it replaces, so a caption describing the centre was released recording sector:right as its evidence.

VISIBLE_TEXT_RE no longer treats a bare apostrophe as a quotation mark. A templated caption was assembled from approved clauses and never carried a possessive; a composed caption is ordinary prose and does.

The templated candidate contract is removed. Under it the runtime wrote a list of controlled sentences from a fixed predicate table and the model selected among them, so the released wording was the runtime's and the model's contribution was the choice between one approved synonym and another. hdsg.vlm_candidate.v1, its grammar, its two fixtures, validate_candidate, parse_candidate, prompt_packet_text and the approved-clause builder all go with it.

The generative layer is now the composed contract alone. The model writes the caption in its own words with the measured values in the prose and declares each value it stated, and the gate compares every declaration against the Fact Packet.

Three identifiers are retained in enumerations while nothing emits them: hdsg.vlm_candidate.v1 in expected_response_schema, constraint_id and candidate_schema. Records archived before 21 August 2026 carry them, and a frozen schema that cannot validate its own archive is of no use as evidence. approved_text_templates is retained in the prompt packet for the same reason and is optional.

Seven reason codes became unreachable and are retained on the same grounds: RG_CLAUSE_FORMAT_INVALID, RG_REQUIRED_FACT_MISSING, RG_PLACEHOLDER_INVALID, RG_MOVEMENT_FACT_REQUIRED, RG_SUBJECT_MISMATCH, RG_STATE_EXPRESSION_MISMATCH and RG_NEGATION_DETECTED. Each screened a sentence the runtime had written. RG_REQUIRED_FACT_MISSING has no composed equivalent by design, because establishing that free prose covered a required fact would need the linguistic inference the architecture excludes from the safety boundary.

The visual-observation label screen moved into the composed validator. The templated validator checked labels against the action, commentary and prohibited-instruction expressions and the composed one did not, so removing the templated gate would have dropped the check. A label is rendered into the release as prose and is screened as prose.

The prompt packet recorded max_tokens from the templated budget while the composed call sent the caption budget, so the recorded value was 220 where 400 was sent. This is the third defect of that class, after the system prompt digest and the constraint digest, and all three came of a field being populated with the wrong value rather than left absent.

build_release no longer takes a candidate. It renders the deterministic account for the idle state, the pending state and every rejection, and hdsg_composed.build_composed_release calls it for the authority block before substituting an accepted caption's content.

hdsg.question_record.v1 added 23 August 2026. The telemetry record written for each typed question previously stamped itself hdsg.question_route.v1, the schema of the classifier's two-field reply, and failed validation against it. The reply schema is unchanged in shape; its enumeration went from eight topic tokens to three admission tokens when topic routing was withdrawn the same day, which is why its digest and the grammar's have moved.

observation.depth_valid_fraction added 23 August 2026, optional so archives recorded before that date still validate. It replaces a low-light flag that was written as False on every frame; the share of the reasoning band carrying a usable depth reading separated the backlit staircase captures from ordinary room frames where mean brightness did not, the backlit frames being the brighter of the two.

The request catalogue's recorded digest was reissued on 23 August 2026 without a schema-set bump. The edit touched only two _note fields, which no code reads: the question_answer note was cut from five sentences of withdrawn-feature history to the one fact a maintainer cannot get from the code, and the unconstrained_diagnostic note was corrected to say that the mode retains its safety system prompt and therefore measures the architecture against prompting alone rather than against a bare model. No prompt text, instruction or identifier changed, so no run's behaviour differs across the two digests. Provenance does not rest on this manifest in any case: the runtime hashes the catalogue itself into request_catalogue_hash on every run.

The `enabled` flag was removed from the three request profiles on 23 August 2026, and the digest reissued again. It was never set false in any revision of the catalogue, nothing wrote it, and the two blocks added later never carried it, so it described a capability the system did not have. Channels are switched with --answer_questions and --unconstrained, which the run header records. The startup check was extended in the same commit to cover the whole file rather than the three request profiles alone, and was extracted from main so that it can be tested; it could not be before, being one branch inside a function that opens a camera.

The admission grammar's digest was reissued on 23 August 2026 for a comment change alone. Its closing comment had said the artifact awaited a future schema set; the grammar, the schema and both fixtures had already been issued in v5. The replacement records where the three outcome tokens are written and that tests/test_question_route_grammar.py fails if the four copies disagree. No rule changed, so the language the decoder admits is identical across the two digests.

The caption grammar admitted no object numbered zero, and the runtime numbers a detection the tracker holds no identifier for by its position in the list, counting from zero. `object:0` was therefore a permitted fact the decoder could not write: the model was forced onto another digit, naming an object that either did not exist or was not the one measured, and the caption was rejected as an invalid reference or a value mismatch with the reason code blaming the model. No archived run contains object:0, the tracker having issued identifiers from one throughout, so it had never fired; it is reachable in the opening frames of a run and after the tracker loses every track. `object-index` replaces `positive-integer` in fact-id and measurement-id and admits a bare zero but not a padded or signed one. `positive-integer` is retained for the visual observations, whose numbering the model invents and which the gate requires to start at one. The gate already accepted object:0 unchanged, so the grammar was the only obstruction. Both digests reissued 23 August 2026.

hdsg.vlm_caption.v1's stated_value described a tolerance removed when exactness on the written token replaced it. The description is corrected to state that the comparison is exact on the text as the deterministic renderer would display it, with no second acceptable spelling. No constraint changed; the schema validated the same documents before and after.

proposed_label admitted a trailing space and a run of spaces in the schema and in the gate, and never in the grammar, which has always required single spaces between words. The label is rendered as "Possible <label> is visible in the <bearing>", so a trailing space reached the display as a double space. The decoder could not produce one, which is why it was never seen; the check meant to be authoritative was nonetheless looser than the constraint it backs up. Both are tightened to the grammar's shape and the 48 character limit is stated as maxLength, the pattern no longer carrying it. Found by the agreement test rather than by reading: the three statements of each field shape, in GBNF, in JSON Schema and in Python, are now probed with the same strings and must return the same verdict.

Three value shapes in the caption grammar are named rules rather than inline expressions, so that the agreement test can reference them: visual-identifier, proposed-label and bearing-value. The language admitted is unchanged by the naming.

motion_decision no longer admits null. The release builder reads ACTION_TEMPLATES[(motion_decision, selected_sector)], a table with no null key, so a packet carrying null would raise KeyError rather than degrade: the schema admitted a value the runtime cannot survive. It was sought 1260 ways across every combination of intent, advisory, response mode, object presence and sector reading and never produced, and appears in no archived record, so narrowing the enum invalidates nothing already written.

The configuration block, audited 23 August 2026. binding_tie_margin is removed: recorded as a literal 0.15, read by no line of code, present only in this record, the schema and one fixture, so the block stated two tie thresholds of which one was fiction. Removed rather than nulled by decision, the archive being development data that can be recorded again; records written before this date carry the field and no longer validate.

code_version is added, carrying the commit, the branch and whether the working tree was edited. software_version and rule_set_version are literals that have never changed and configuration_hash covers only the configuration files, so nothing identified the Python. On the same day the caution rule stopped counting distance bands and started counting metres, and an object's band stopped being trusted and started being derived: two changes to what the walker does, leaving every field in the block identical. It is the same defect fixed for the model on 22 August, where the header named the model typed on the command line rather than the weights the endpoint had loaded. Resolved once and cached, three subprocess calls having no place on the event path. Every field is null where git is unavailable. The fixture pins a zero commit, a generated fixture that carried the live commit changing on every commit for no reason.

sector_geometry now records left_max_fraction and right_min_fraction, and takes its row band from what the caller measured with rather than restating literals. horizontal_divisions said how many sectors there were and never where they divided, so reading an archived record required still holding the pipeline.yaml that hashes to its configuration_hash. The row band moved to sector.band_top_fraction and band_bottom_fraction in pipeline.yaml, having been written out three times, in compute_lane_state, in valid_depth_fraction and in this record, with nothing comparing them.

The fact packet fixture recorded a sector clear distance of 2.0 while the shipped value was 1.8, so the frozen example of a well formed record stated a threshold no run used. The generator now reads the runtime constants.
